element_fields.description_en:
The departure and arrival city codes, separated by Chinese commas "，".
Pass 0 to disable city restrictions. Note: When cities are unrestricted, ensure hotel travel standards are passed for all cities.
When the allowed booking category is 0/6/21/25, three-letter airport codes or six-digit city codes are accepted.
When the allowed booking category is any other value, only six-digit city codes are accepted.
city_set and city_code_set must have a one-to-one correspondence.
Note: When the itinerary includes a flight-type itinerary, if the specified city has no airport, flight itineraries cannot be booked.

[Three-letter airport code data](https://btrip-doc.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/base-data/btrip-flight-city-data.xlsx)
[Administrative division city code data](https://btrip-doc.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/base-data/btrip-hotel-city-data.xlsx)
